summary: Run the project's existing checks on GitHub pushes and pull requests, with a single required result and selective jobs for monorepos.
description: Run the project's existing checks on GitHub pushes and pull requests. The workflow reads tool versions from project files and gives branch protection one aggregate result; monorepos can filter work by affected area. Default-preset guidance includes SHA-pinned actions and limited permissions. The fragment defines CI configuration, while deployment and release publishing belong to separate fragments.
seoDescription: GitHub Actions CI that reuses project commands, filters monorepo jobs and exposes one required check with limited workflow permissions.

projectExamples.title: API pull request checks
projectExamples.description: Run the API's lint, typecheck, tests and build before changes merge. Configure branch protection to require the aggregate result.

projectExamples.title: Split frontend and backend checks
projectExamples.description: Run checks for changed Python and React areas while including shared-contract changes in the frontend filter. Reuse the Makefile targets.

plain.whatItIs: Runs the project's existing checks on GitHub whenever code is pushed or a pull request, a proposed change, is opened or updated.
goodAt: Giving GitHub's merge rules one combined result to wait for
Running the same checks you run locally, using the project's own commands
Running only the checks for the parts of a multi-app repository that changed
notGoodAt: Deploying the app or publishing releases; add a deployment or release add-on.
Projects hosted outside GitHub, such as on GitLab.
